sourceChecks.text: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” The LORD’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA24:16で本文がアラウナ（オルナン）を名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA24:18で本文がアラウナ（オルナン）を名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA24:20で本文がアラウナ（オルナン）を名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to the LORD, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA24:21で本文がアラウナ（オルナン）を名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA24:22で本文がアラウナ（オルナン）を名指す。

sourceChecks.text: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May the LORD your God accept you.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA24:23で本文がアラウナ（オルナン）を名指す。

sourceChecks.text: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA24:24で本文がアラウナ（オルナン）を名指す。
